name: rulebisect
description: Investigate reproducible Codex instruction failures and compare proposed repository rules with independent checks.

interface.longDescription: Investigate reproducible Codex repository-instruction failures, reduce a failing instruction set, and compare proposed rules across independent task checks. Includes the local RuleBisect engine: Python 3.11+ and Git are required; real experiments also require the installed, authenticated Codex CLI and use the user's model quota or billing within an agreed execution budget. Setup, planning, verifier checks, saved-report review and deterministic demos make no model calls. Reports distinguish simulations, verifier checks, regressions and uncertain observations. A reduced candidate is a failing reproducer, not a verified repair or proof of causation. This skill is for Codex execution environments with access to the user's repository.
defaultPrompt: Show me an instruction regression demo without calling a model.
Help define an independent check for my Codex task.
Review my saved RuleBisect evidence and explain the next step.

publication.release_notes: Initial self-contained Codex Skill distribution with RuleBisect engine 0.7.0, bounded experiment workflows and offline evidence.
